howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose DPI
howto.text: Higher DPI = sharper PNG. 96 for screen, 150 default, 300 for print archival.

howto.name: Download a ZIP of PNGs
howto.text: Each page becomes one PNG file with lossless compression. PNG preserves transparency if present.

faq.a: PNG is lossless — text and graphics stay crisp. JPG compresses better for photos but introduces compression artifacts on text.
Roughly 200-500 KB per page at 150 DPI for typical text content; up to 2-3 MB at 300 DPI.
PDF transparency layers flatten during rasterization but the result PNG has alpha if the PDF page had transparent regions over the page background.
